title: Anti AI horde getting at you in the comments under your post? I’ll back you up!
author: New_Complaint5282
selftext:
I’ve posted about my game yesterday, got some anti AI deep thinkers traffic there. At first I decided to just ignore it, but… I just couldn’t help myself and started “discussing” with them.   
Because this is so annoying. You spend countless hours on something. The newest tech gives you opportunities you always dreamt of. You are very excited. And then this guy comes. Spends 3 seconds looking at your post. And he writes:

Slop

Oh my… 

So I started answering. This is obviously a waste of my time and energy, but im in that kind of mood right now 🤣  
Anyway, I realised I’m being attacked by a horde, but I’m the only one on my side.   
So I thought I’d do something good today. If you’re in a similar situation, let me know, I’ll drop some comments in your post. But only if your project has the quality - if you spam the slop, you’re on your own 😁

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Your post was automatically removed because it looks like it's mainly about anti-AI attitudes elsewhere, without discussing game development using AI. This sub is focused on game development using generative AI (Rule 1).

A mod will review this removal and can restore the post if it was a mistake. You don't need to do anything, but you can [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev) if you want to add context.
